title: Design System: Xavier GUERET — Personal Site

display.purpose: Hero H1 only. Source Serif 4, weight 600, italic cut available for the one accent word.

headline.purpose: Section H2s. Source Serif 4 roman cut, weight 500. Replaces the current sans bold treatment.

title.purpose: Article card titles, related-content titles. Geist weight 600.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy. Geist weight 400 at 1.0625rem, clamped near 65ch.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, metadata, pill text, button labels. Sentence case, never uppercase.

mono.purpose: Code blocks inside articles only. JetBrains Mono. Never in nav, eyebrows, metadata.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system. Applied on :focus-visible of every interactive element. No hover shadows, no ambient elevation.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing for color, border, and background transitions. No bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: State transitions (hover color shift, border shift).

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Background fills and larger color shifts.

narrative.overview: The system is a personal site written from Guadeloupe at dawn — when the ocean is still dark, the sand is already warm, and the sky is opening. The warm sand of the page and the cool ink of the type set up the system's defining tension: warm/cool, exactly as the trade winds meet the sea. The register is brand: design IS the product. The aesthetic is committed, not restrained — teal-océan carries 30–60% of any given page. Motion is restrained: state transitions only, no entrance choreography. Reading is the primary task, and the system's job is to disappear into it.
keyCharacteristics: Warm sand fields (sable-crème, coquille) replace #ffffff and slate-50 as default backgrounds.
Deep teal-océan as the committed brand color, carried on hero, navigation, primary CTAs.
Corail soleil as a 5%-or-less accent: a single signal, never wallpaper.
Serif display + sans body, neither in the impeccable reflex-reject list.
Flat by default: depth comes from warm/cool color tension, not shadows.
Italic carries the soft voice; the roman cut carries the technical voice.
Mono is reserved for code inside articles. Mono in navigation, eyebrows, metadata = costume.

rules.name: The Warm/Cool Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are warm (hue 65). Text is cool (hue 220). The tension between them is the system's signature. Never tint both toward the same hue; never use a fully-neutral gray.

rules.name: The 30-60 Teal Rule
rules.body: Teal-Océan must carry 30–60% of any given fold's visible area: navbar, hero block, primary CTA, or a band of section background — pick one or two per screen, never zero, never the entire page.

rules.name: The 5% Coral Rule
rules.body: Corail Soleil is a one-shot accent: a single state, a single element, never repeated within a fold.

rules.name: The No-White Rule
rules.body: #ffffff is banned. So is #000000. So is color: white; as a literal value. All neutrals come from the named tokens.

rules.name: The Italic Voice Rule
rules.body: The italic cut of the display serif carries the soft, oral, Caribbean-voice half of the brand. The roman cut carries the technical half. Reach for italic only when the word is the voice.

rules.name: The Mono Restraint Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for actual code inside articles and for explicit terminal mockups. Mono in eyebrows, dates, tags, metadata, navigation, body copy, headings: forbidden.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Eyebrows, labels, button text, navigation: sentence case, never UPPERCASE, never Title Case. The letter-spacing: 0.2em uppercase tracking is forbidden.

rules.name: The 65ch Rule
rules.body: Body line length never exceeds 75ch and rarely drops below 60ch.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. There is no ambient elevation in the system. Shadows appear only as a focus signal, never as visual hierarchy.

rules.name: The No-Lift Hover Rule
rules.body: Hover transforms must change at most one property: color, or border, or background. Stacking translateY + shadow + scale is forbidden.

rules.name: The No Side-Stripe Rule
rules.body: border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent is forbidden on every component. Use full 1px borders, background tints, leading numerals, or nothing.

rules.name: The One-Hover Rule
rules.body: Hover on any component transitions exactly one property: color, border, or background.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Buttons Rule
rules.body: Button labels are sentence-case, never UPPERCASE, never Title Case.

dos: Do use OKLCH for every color token. Hex codes are an implementation artifact.
Do put teal-ocean on 30–60% of every fold (navbar + one block, hero band, primary CTA + section anchor).
Do keep corail-soleil to one element per fold maximum.
Do tint warm neutrals to hue 65 and cool neutrals to hue 220. Never both toward the same hue.
Do pair Source Serif 4 (display) with Geist (body). Italic of the display cut for one accent word at a time.
Do size body type at 1.0625rem with line-height 1.6 and max-width clamped near 65ch.
Do set buttons, eyebrows, labels, and nav links in sentence case.
Do make hovers shift exactly one property — color OR border OR background.
Do redesign dark mode as its own scene (the night ocean), not a hue-inverted derivative.
Do use the focus-ring token (3px teal halo) on every interactive element.
donts: Don't ship #ffffff, #000000, or color: white; in any production code.
Don't use Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, Outfit, DM Sans, Space Grotesk, Instrument Sans, Fraunces, Newsreader, Cormorant, or any other family in the impeccable reflex-reject list.
Don't ship the navy + Facebook-blue palette (#1e293b + #3b5998). That combination is named anti-reference 2 in PRODUCT.md.
Don't use border-left-4 or border-right-4 (or any side-stripe ≥2px) as a colored accent.
Don't use background-clip: text with a gradient (gradient text).
Don't stack hover effects: translateY + shadow + scale together is forbidden.
Don't use animate-bounce or any bouncy/elastic easing. Motion uses ease-out exponential curves only.
Don't UPPERCASE eyebrows with tracking-[0.2em] — that is the editorial-magazine second-order trap.
Don't put monospace on anything that isn't actual code or a terminal mockup.
Don't repeat the same card grid layout for two content types in a row.
Don't invent a Skills section with progress bars or a Years of experience counter.
Don't ship a Kubernetes wheel, Docker whale, or terminal-screenshot hero.
Don't drift toward editorial-magazine-on-recovery from corporate-navy.
